description: Fraud / lead-quality check for ONE phone number. Looks the number up and returns a 0-100 risk score, a level (low/medium/high/unknown) and the reasons. Optionally pass expected_name (e.g. the name on an order or signup) to check it against the names on record. The score is a transparent heuristic over spam reports, line type, name consistency and name match, NOT a verdict: 'unknown' means no record, which is not the same as safe. Use before shipping cash-on-delivery orders, accepting signups, or calling back a lead. Costs 1 credit when a name is found.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. AE, SA, EG.

expected_name.description: Name the customer gave (Latin or Arabic script). Compared against the primary name and aliases on record.

phone.description: Phone number, ideally in international E.164 format, e.g. +971501234567. Spaces and dashes are tolerated. A national number (e.g. 0501234567) also needs `country`.

name: callerkit_assess_number_risk
title: Assess phone number risk
